title: The Number That Did Not Know

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The slate is read twice and the account stands once. Four readings in a year are four, and a rule made out of them is a thing with nobody standing under it to pay. The grain lies covered under wool and the number that goes over it does not know what it cost.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of Sill, told under the moot-post at Bone's first reading

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and nine to three hundred and eleven days, six months and one hundred and twenty-nine to one hundred and thirty-one days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone, never a break in the narration. That register reads the body as a wound inventoried in its old order --- crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform --- and reads the world the way a trauma bay is read, checking the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; the carried fire kept in fours with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night; the told figure beside the paid with four arithmetics of the year now behind one printed figure, Bone's first reading gone up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind Frost's three, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space between, four readings four and not one account with the finding on a place of its own and no payer. The dressed grain lies covered under wool at the rack end, turned with a progressively lighter touch and read over by a number that does not know what it cost; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays the fourth of four held changes on four places and not a rule; the twice-mended pot lifts on Sella's thumb where the wire crosses the crack with the crack left showing; the seven walked-around places go around with a look and a wide step and no number; the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate on its flat stone stay weather entered nowhere; nine hands with Ilva's ninth strip unread and offstage and no tenth; the Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand; the burned slate at five tellings with a finger between the fifth and the four; the row at five askings with no witness; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Tarn's loan uncalled, Jorra's promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed, Garl held in objects with his name unspoken; the house's not-doings kept on a place apart from the boy's own gaps with a finger between. The six small coordinations of the hand are the answers one hundred and ninety-three through one hundred and ninety-eight, each an object and not a power, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Tenth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{309}{Bone 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of the month's first Account-day and market. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and ninety-second answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; do not recap Chapter 85, the reader has just read it. Carry 308 to 309 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-nine days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and nine days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 7, 8 or 9 comes in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment --- not the returned half-check, not the five burned-slate tellings, not the hare gone into the weather. Bone 10 arrives on its own morning: the Cross and the bell are not brought early into a day that had not earned them, and now the day has earned them. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. He knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one: the fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand, the river's water over water under the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot (T061/T082, T088). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a row with two gaps and figures neither, glances once at the clay jar, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread. The widow's mark hangs where it hangs and is not touched, because a market-day morning under this roof is not an opening; five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, and the ear-sentence stops at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end (T036/T076). Jorra at the wheel-shed edge keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray parted as clot from vessel; the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings (T035/T031/T065/T095). The hand comes up an inch and takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's low note: the one hundred and ninety-third answer, a restraint and not a payment, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: The First Reading of Bone
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 309, no new dated heading: late morning through the going of the light at the Cross, under the moot-post and the reading block, at the pot board and the market's edge, below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing, and home under the Vail roof. THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T015/T041/T047, T077): Bone's first reading comes to the Cross and changes the district's arithmetic for the month in a way that cannot be changed back. Two hundred lean in over the reading block while eight pigs go over the wet boards; Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wipes his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passes a finger over the figure, reads one in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket --- once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- calls the levy and denies it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and goes off up the clay road toward High Kiln with the box locked and Bone's first true subtraction inside beside the three from Frost, believing he has done a kindness. The printed figure stands unchallenged, the figure read is still not the figure paid, no signature stands on the space between. FOUR ARITHMETICS OF THE YEAR now stand behind one printed figure; four are four and a rule made from them is refused, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). The dressed grain lying covered under wool at the rack end is read over by a number that does not know what it cost, and the reading answers nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15, or the hare gone off toward the north gate road answered with the weather (T077, T098 carried). Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, stands half a pace off through the reading and the bell, and carries him home at the going of the light saying nothing. The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, its gap not made a seventh hearing, a fifth pull or a payer (T078). Hessa Rale takes the slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on and writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, answering the question put and not the one behind it with I don't read it. I carry it. There's a difference, and the road doesn't care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I've got a road to walk; no figure comes off the slate and the eighth hand stays eight (T080). Below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing, slate to his forearm with the writing inward, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone; he is not Marra, the Drawing collector or Berr and is filed apart (T090). Across the square at the pot board a silent woman's sweetish lead-glaze green stays the seventh colour, clay under her nails and a pale line on the back of one hand, turning a cup a quarter and setting it back; at the market's edge a small shape in cast-offs, a man's shoulders on a child's frame, a gap where a front tooth and a green sliver on a string, turns half a beat after a pot is set down with a small flat sound. Both are sightings only with no eighth of either, never named Fenna or Ulda in the narration, no loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance; the foundling's half-turn is a turn after the knock (T050/T051, T033/T034 held). The fifth burned-slate telling is carried through the reading untouched --- no witness, no sixth, no hand at the flame, no payer --- and the claim gathers interest against Jorra's ungiven promise while he neither pays nor refuses (T035/T031/T065/T095). Late in the going of the light outside the wool the hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's note: the one hundred and ninety-fourth answer, a restraint and not a payment, not carried into the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap or the river's low over lower.

scenes.title: The Day After the Reading
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{310}{Bone 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 10 --- not the reading, not the four arithmetics, not the bell's gap, not the sightings at the Cross --- is brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 309 to 310 exact, six months and one hundred and thirty days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and ten days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the old order: the crust gone ever stiffer and leathery two inches from the ear with its unnamed empty place and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody will perform. The ease cold puts on a face is not ease; a cold patient cannot clot; a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly, never hurried, never rubbed, never set too near the fire. He wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; the surgeon's knowing buys nothing at two inches of air and the argument between the two registers is the work, not a virtue (T060/T086). Under the roof the house keeps by its not-doings and the boy keeps his finger between those omissions and his own kept gaps (T061/T082). Sella to the fire before the basket, the instruction to the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket; the widow's mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings; the twice-mended pot lifted with the thumb first where the wire crossed the crack before the weight came on the handle and both proverbs said to the pot and the fire, the crack left showing (T058/T079, T009/T013/T092). At the rack end the dressed grain lies under wool and is turned with a lighter touch and no figure; the reading that passed over it on Bone 10 is not brought back as a lesson --- a number went over it that did not know what it cost, and the finding stays on a place of its own with no payer, not laid across the house's not-doings, the returned half-check or his own kept gaps (T077, T015/T041/T047). At the kindling Tarn keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the sill's edge beside Garl's unforged collector sentence about the man who turned back at the frozen ford, no name on the man and no figure on the debt; he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, draws the breath he does not spend, and says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying. A tenth stopping is not given before the seventh year at its very end and the loan stays uncalled, no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076). At the wheel-shed edge Jorra keeps meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note that pot will give three turns ahead and withholds it from any kiln-master come up from High Kiln who would call it early; his bent finger stands in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and he reads one iron with two bites, joined to no kiln and entered in no slate. The burned slate stays at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness; he's not Vail stays sealed and the promise of the foundling's name is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101). The hand comes up for the one hundred and ninety-fifth answer: an empty interval set beside a held interval with the finger brought down between and neither spent, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named.

scenes.title: What the Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 11 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the worked strips as a direction, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate with the fold over his ears against the river wind and the instruction going to the wool and the wind and never to the basket. She goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out --- seven places kept by going around them, no eighth likeness stood up as a row and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). At the yard well the stayed frost gone off the north lip while the yard looked elsewhere, the skin on the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on the flat stone out of the path of feet stay three coverings in three places, all called weather and entered nowhere, a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). Bone's hunts and repairs go on as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures; a cost asked of the month is answered with the weather and a direction that leaves no entry, and no man pricing a repair stands up in the yard to be asked (T077). Tarn's stroke goes over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check; the returned half-check of Bone 8 stays on the flagstone's own place with the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat --- four held changes on four places, not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause and no payer named; a thing kept by not being made again is still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T100, T061/T082 held). The small keepings stay small and are not brought forward: the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf stays unread under the finger laid on top of the shelf's front edge; Ilva's strip stays in her sleeve offstage, her ninth hand nine with no tenth and no figure coming off the wood; the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying stay beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand with a finger between every pair; the seventh green remains a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth; the reed-cutter's cord lies where no Court thumb has read it; the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate stays at the out-of-line landing. None is a sign, a lesson, a mending, a cause or a payment and none is carried under the roof (T100, T080, T050/T051, T033/T034, T099, T090). The carried fire answers four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand and nobody supplies the pull; under the finger's-width door the river goes water over water without a number put to it; overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot. Three counts in three places and none rises into another (T061/T082, T088). In the small hours the hand takes a small intake and sets it beside a small letting-go with a finger between, the half-beat of a pot's set-down laid beside it and none promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh or a payment: the one hundred and ninety-sixth answer. The file lies open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap, every tray parted by the width of a finger and nothing moved.

scenes.title: Four Are Four
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{311}{Bone 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 10 or 11 is brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 310 to 311 exact, six months and one hundred and thirty-one days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and eleven days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the old order: the crust gone leathery and brown-edged two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third to make the row come out even; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint of the wrist where the wool has ridden back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure and that a cold patient will seem better before he is worse; the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; both are true and the second is louder and neither wins (T060/T086). The finding that four arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure is kept on a place of its own with no payer under it: not a lesson, a grievance, a mending, a doctrine or a rule, and not laid across the house's not-doings, the dressed grain covered and unfigured under wool, the four held changes on four places, the returned half-check or the boy's own kept gaps --- the edges nearly touch and the finger goes between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). A finding with no payer is a thing that can be carried a long way without becoming a rule. Under the roof the widow's mark is not touched at a shelf, a well, a rack, a morning, a hearth or a bed, because the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour and five openings in five months are five and not a rule; the next opening stands far off in a later month's first firing, not hoped for and not counted toward (T058/T079). Tarn at the kindling with the knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where it can slip, Ash worked into the creases of his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and no scrubbing lifting it, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist holding what little light there is and giving it back, his chest tight since the dark and the Seed 16 breath still unspent. The ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops with no figure and no name: a remembered ninth stopping, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven. Up in the Debt Loft, which reaches the boy only as a sound with a direction, the warm stone Sella gave him in the winter Garl died lies cold in its unmarked pot and he does not reconcile it with the debt and does not try, which is not forgiveness; the loan stays uncalled and no collector comes up the clay road or goes down it (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, keeps dusty and clean forearms apart, and grows quieter when the burned-slate saying goes around; the fifth telling stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, no sixth, no witness, no hand at the flame and no payer, and the seed waits on the far-off calling-in of his promise, not a confession and not a payment (T035/T031/T065/T095). The hand comes up for the one hundred and ninety-seventh answer: a small intake held against the kiln's fourth low pull as it gives and let go whole on the river's note, not carried into the missing fifth, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 311, Bone 12, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). The three coverings at the well stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The returned half-check stays on the flagstone's own place with the three older held changes beside it; four are four and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause, and a thing kept by not being made again is still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held). The four arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space; four readings are four and not one account, and the finding sits on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes or the boy's own kept gaps --- edges nearly touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). The burned-slate word stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four; a sixth telling is not due on a day that has not earned one; no witness stands, no hand is named at the flame, and the seed waits on the far-off calling-in of Jorra's promise, not a confession and not a payment (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Garl stays in objects and not in a story, his salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg, the wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean and hollow that Sella will let no one fill, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept both; his proverb goes to the pot and the fire and never to a person and the debt against a firing of tiles circles without a name, neither paid, settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092). In the small hours he turns out the file as he once turned instruments out on a towel at the end of a list, laying each thing on its own place and asking nothing of any of them; six hearings stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell stays in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, nine hands stay nine with the strip in a sleeve and no tenth, the row stays at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth. Nothing has been spent to make a row come out even and nothing has stood up out of its place as a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule. At the very end of the day the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note and takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same low note, a restraint and not a payment, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, carrying it into neither the carried fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left behind in the square nor the river's low over lower. The one hundred and ninety-eighth answer is exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; it does not stand up as any of the things it refuses and no payer is named to it. The older man takes a clean satisfaction in the keeping of the number; the infant wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped; both are true and the second is louder and neither wins, and the argument is the work. The hand comes down on the river's note and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Three hundred and eleven stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and thirty-one days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed, and Garl Vail's name has not been spoken under the roof the same number. One hundred and ninety-eight honest answers stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither the number nor the small hand-movings that made it stands up and calls itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Nothing on the twelfth of Bone was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended: no sixth asking, no tenth hand, no tenth stopping, no seventh hearing, no sixth telling, no third shut-room telling, no fourth shaping, no eighth green or shape, no fifth pulled supplied and no payer beneath the pot's mended handle. The river's low note goes quiet under the finger's-width door; the silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet; the file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap, and Bone goes on without a boundary drawn. Bone 13 (Day 312), the first morning of the middle working week, stands one morning beyond the reach of this day and has not been brought into it.
